description: Full structured record for one Federal Register document: status, agencies, publication/comment/effective dates, RINs, dockets, CFR parts, official links, linked rulemakings, deadline history, any earlier Public Inspection filing, and (when configured) the Regulations.gov docket title, comment period and posted comment count. Also finds documents still on Public Inspection.
name: get_regulatory_document
title: Get a Federal Register document
